title: Someone took me here last night, what a wild experience
content: I was fully lucid and able to look around freely, someone had taken me, by the hand ( I saw my hand holding theirs but like....infrared?) and said these words to me " I really wanted to show you this place, and I wanted to see if I could take you here " they led me through rooms of this outdoor ruin, covered in graffiti, absolutely breathtaking towering walls made of stone. Thank you for taking me here , wow, I will cherish this dream forever
